# Petrarch

*1304 – 1374 · Italian · [Renaissance humanism](../movements/renaissance-humanism.md)*

Italian poet and man of letters, the initiator of [humanism](../movements/renaissance-humanism.md): he sought out Cicero's manuscripts and made reading the ancients a school of life, against the dialectic of the scholastics.
